mapper.sql: select a.id, a.source_id, s.name as source_name, a.title, a.summary, a.content, a.original_url, a.language, a.tags, a.sentiment, a.keywords, a.publish_time, a.fetch_time, a.is_pushed, a.push_time, a.read_count, a.status, a.keyword_id, a.is_real, a.relevance, a.relevance_reason, a.keyword_mentioned, a.importance, a.type_config_id, tc.type_name, a.fetch_origin, a.create_by, a.create_time, a.update_by, a.update_time, a.remark from news_article a left join news_source s on a.source_id = s.id left join news_type_config tc on a.type_config_id = tc.id
mapper.select: where a.is_pushed = '0' and a.status = '0' order by a.fetch_time asc

select (select count(*) from news_article where status = '0') as totalArticles, (select count(*) from news_article where status = '0' and date(fetch_time) = curdate()) as todayArticles, (select count(*) from news_article a left join news_source s on a.source_id = s.id where a.status = '0' and (s.type = '0' or (s.type is null and (a.language is null or a.language != 'en'))) ) as domesticCount, (select count(*) from news_article a left join news_source s on a.source_id = s.id where a.status = '0' and (s.type = '1' or (s.type is null and a.language = 'en')) ) as foreignCount

select date_format(fetch_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:00') as hour, count(*) as count from news_article where status = '0' and fetch_time >= date_sub(now(), interval 24 hour) group by date_format(fetch_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:00') order by hour asc

select COALESCE(s.name, a.source_name, '其他') as name, count(*) as value from news_article a left join news_source s on a.source_id = s.id where a.status = '0' group by COALESCE(s.name, a.source_name, '其他') order by value desc
select sentiment as name, count(*) as value from news_article where status = '0' and sentiment is not null group by sentiment

select jt.tag_name as name, count(*) as value from news_article, json_table(tags, '$[*]' columns (tag_name varchar(100) path '$')) as jt where status = '0' and tags is not null group by jt.tag_name order by value desc limit 15
mapper.insert: insert into news_article ( source_id, source_name, title, summary, content, original_url, language, tags, sentiment, keywords, publish_time, is_pushed, status, keyword_id, is_real, relevance, relevance_reason, keyword_mentioned, importance, type_config_id, fetch_origin, create_by, create_time )values( #{sourceId}, #{sourceName}, #{title}, #{summary}, #{content}, #{originalUrl}, #{language}, #{tags}, #{sentiment}, #{keywords}, #{publishTime}, #{isPushed}, #{status}, #{keywordId}, #{isReal}, #{relevance}, #{relevanceReason}, #{keywordMentioned}, #{importance}, #{typeConfigId}, #{fetchOrigin}, #{createBy}, sysdate() )
mapper.update: update news_article set is_pushed = '1', push_time = sysdate() where id = #{id}
mapper.delete:
delete from news_article where id in
#{id}
